content: I went to an event last night. There was a lot of AI Kool Aid consumed. It was an impressive crowd though – pioneers, luminaries, legends even! As is often the case, I ended up spending most of the time with a single person. This person told me about a company called Bronze, who seems to be doing some really cool work at the intersection of AI and sound. After talking to this person, I left with a long-time personal friend for deep conversation while we walked on the beach, eventually making our way to a late (for me) dinner.
